Audit Issue (Point): www vs. non-www — full site duplication
Original State (Before): No redirect rules configured for www to non-www requests.
Updated State (After): Added RewriteEngine rules to redirect all www requests to the secure non-www domain (https://mounteko.com).
Primary Impact: Splitting SEO ranking signals and indexation bloat.

Audit Issue (Point): Test blog post ("test-blog") live and indexed
Original State (Before): All blog posts, including test posts, were queried and indexed.
Updated State (After): Added a boot() method global scope "excludeTestBlog" to automatically exclude any blog post with slug "test-blog" from search indexing and front-end queries.

Audit Issue (Point): Lorem-ipsum / placeholder copy live in production
Original State (Before): Blog index templates contained generic filler "Lorem ipsum..." descriptions.
Updated State (After): Replaced all placeholder copy with descriptive, high-quality summaries matching the topics of the articles (enterprise AI, MLOps, AI assistants, and ROI).
Primary Impact: Negative content quality and helpful-content search signals.

Original State (Before): Contact page contained a hardcoded phone link (tel:00-976-561-008).
Updated State (After): Updated the phone link target dynamically using settings from the database: href="tel:{{ preg_replace('/[^0-9+]/', '', settingValue('phone')) }}".
Primary Impact: Local SEO entity inconsistency and broken customer calls.

Original State (Before): Product page CTA section contained a hardcoded country prefix (+91) prepended to the phone setting.
Updated State (After): Formatted the phone link dynamically to clean non-numeric characters and route directly to the configured phone setting: href="tel:{{ preg_replace('/[^0-9+]/', '', settingValue('phone')) }}".
Primary Impact: NAP inconsistency and lost lead conversion paths.

Audit Issue (Point): "Privacy Policy" link points to the FAQ page
Original State (Before): The Privacy Policy link in the footer pointed to the FAQ page (route('faq')).
Updated State (After): Modified the Privacy Policy link to route to the new dedicated Privacy Policy page: route('privacyPolicy').
Primary Impact: Legal compliance, user trust, and site credibility.

Audit Issue (Point): "Privacy Policy" link points to the FAQ page (Route Setup)
Original State (Before): No route existed for the /privacy-policy page.
Updated State (After): Added a GET route for 'privacy-policy' calling the HomeController's privacyPolicy method: Route::get('privacy-policy', [HomeController::class, 'privacyPolicy'])->name('privacyPolicy').

Audit Issue (Point): "Privacy Policy" link points to the FAQ page (Controller Method)
Original State (Before): No controller method existed to handle Privacy Policy page rendering.
Updated State (After): Added a public function privacyPolicy() method to return the new privacy blade view.

Audit Issue (Point): "Privacy Policy" link points to the FAQ page (New View File)
Original State (Before): The dedicated Privacy Policy page file did not exist [NEW].
Updated State (After): Created a new Blade template containing standard privacy headers, compliance information, data collection details, and dynamically loading the contact email.
Primary Impact: Legal compliance and lack of E-E-A-T signals.

Audit Issue (Point): Empty/templated meta keywords, unaudited titles & descriptions
Original State (Before): Meta keyword tag had a typo (name="keywods") and keywords/description fields had no default fallbacks.
Updated State (After): Corrected tag name to "keywords" and defined robust default fallback values for page title, meta-keywords, and meta-descriptions to cover all lines of business.

Original State (Before): No JSON-LD structured data was present on the site pages.
Updated State (After): Integrated a JSON-LD Schema markup block for "ProfessionalService" to define company name, logo, address, phone number, and social media entity profiles.
Primary Impact: Ineligibility for search rich snippets and AIO/GEO citation sources.

Original State (Before): The main company logo img tag in the header had an empty alt attribute (alt="").
Updated State (After): Added dynamic alt text reading the company name setting: alt="{{ settingValue('company Name') ?? 'Mounteko Global Solutions' }}".
Primary Impact: Poorer accessibility, image search visibility, and crawling quality.

Audit Issue (Point): Conflicting brand story (new venture vs. "25+ years")
Original State (Before): A design badge claimed "25+ Years of Experience" which conflicted with Mounteko's positioning as a modern, newly rebranded AI-focused startup.
Updated State (After): Modified the overlay badge text to state "24/7 Managed IT Support" to align with their active service offering and resolve trust/E-E-A-T conflicts.

Audit Issue (Point): Primary CTAs link to "#" / broken mailto link
Original State (Before): Buttons like "Check out our services", "Learn More" links under service cards, and "Talk to an IT Expert" were linked to "#" (dead links).
Updated State (After): Replaced all "#" links with valid destinations: anchor tags to services section (#core-services), routes to specific pages (contactUs, services.network-architecture, security, managed_it, etc.), and configured modal trigger for assessment.
Primary Impact: Lost customer leads, high bounce rates, and wasted crawl budget.

Audit Issue (Point): Primary CTAs link to "#" / broken mailto link
Original State (Before): CTA buttons and case study arrow links in the template pointed to "#" (dead links).
Updated State (After): Updated these links to route to the main Contact Us page (route('contactUs')) to facilitate user conversion.
Primary Impact: Broken conversion paths on service pages.

Original State (Before): The llms.txt crawlability file did not exist [NEW].
Updated State (After): Created a public llms.txt file to serve as a clean, markdown-based overview of services, core pages, and contacts specifically formatted for AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.).
